scope: The reviewed model-provider switch of the staging Workers (M3 PR-2; ADR-0022 items 7 and 10; the M5 Stripe switch's protocol), on since the model-provider-on commit (docs/briefs/model-provider-on.md). On: the staging api, broker and orchestrator carry MORROW_MODEL_PROVIDER anthropic, the orchestrator also the reviewed MORROW_DATABASE_BINDING_JSON (byte-equal to the api's), and the broker requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, the owner's key, placed from reviewed main with `npm run staging:put-secret -- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (read from the owner's chmod-600 file anthropic-api-key; never printed, never on a command line). Until it is placed, gate 6 stops every deploy before any upload (STAGING_BROKER_SECRETS_MISMATCH, next run_staging_put_secret_then_gh_run_rerun), and a broker without a well-formed key holds every modelRespond (BROKER_HELD, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE) before any input, database or provider access. monthly_spend_limit_usd is the monthly spend limit of the Anthropic Console workspace the owner uses for Morrow's key, as stated by the owner and not observed by Claude: asked in chat on 2026-10-25 (observed_on, the date it was recorded) to tell Claude that limit, the owner answered verbatim "Anthropic limit 100$". Claude did not open the Console. The prerequisite of M3 owner decision 14 (ADR-0035 items 5 and 8.2), "Disconnect store", merged in #53 (ed5c70e5). The per-action approval of the first model call this record once required (CLAUDE.md before ADR-0035) is superseded by ADR-0035 item 4's standing approval, which covers test runs and live evals within the spend caps (this limit and the caps in code, ADR-0022 item 11); the first call comes from the owner's own Listings request in the workspace. Off (the committed state until 2026-10-25): the broker requires no model secret and its modelRespond answers BROKER_HELD (MODEL_UNAVAILABLE) before any input, database or provider access; run admission answers 503 runs_unavailable before any reservation; ListingsRunWorkflow throws dispatch_disabled before any step and the cron starts nothing. Turning it off again is the reverse commit, then the key's removal, in the order gate 6 requires (the brief). edge:check refuses any mixed state; production has no switch until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR.
